description: One committed edit of a memory: the id, the values the reader left in TmMemoryPanel's editor and the set of fields that actually MOVED. A host applies only what changed instead of diffing two snapshots of its own store, and it can refuse a field it owns — Fields is a subset of the panel's EditableFields, never a superset. Reported through OnEditItem; the legacy text-only OnEdit callback keeps working exactly as before for a host that has not opted into the extra fields.
usageExample:
<TmMemoryPanel Items="_items"
               EditableFields="MemoryEditableFields.All"
               OnEditItem="edit => ApplyAsync(edit.Id, edit.Fields, edit.Text, edit.Category, edit.Source)" />
